words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 《创世记》记载了上帝创造天地万物的故事。(《Chuàngshìjì》 jìzǎi le Shàngdì chuàngzào tiāndì wànwù de gùshì.) — Genesis records the story of God creating heaven, earth, and all things.
《出埃及记》讲述了摩西带领以色列人出埃及的历史。(《Chū'āijíjì》 jiǎngshù le Mōxī dàilǐng Yǐsèliè rén chū Āijí de lìshǐ.) — Exodus recounts the history of Moses leading the Israelites out of Egypt.
《利未记》阐述了律法、圣洁与敬拜礼仪。(《Lìwèijì》 chǎnshù le lǜfǎ, shèngjié yǔ jìngbài lǐyí.) — Leviticus expounds on the law, holiness, and worship rituals.
《民数记》记载了在旷野中的人口普查与行军历程。(《Mínshùjì》 jìzǎi le zài kuàngyě zhōng de rénkǒu pǔchá yǔ xíngjūn lìchéng.) — Numbers records the census in the wilderness and the marching journey.
《申命记》重申了上帝的诫命与摩西临终前的嘱托。(《Shēnmìngjì》 chóngshēn le Shàngdì de jièmìng yǔ Mōxī línzhōng qián de zhǔtuō.) — Deuteronomy reiterates God's commandments and Moses' final exhortations.
《约书亚记》讲述了以色列人进入应许之地的征程。(《Yuēshūyàjì》 jiǎngshù le Yǐsèliè rén jìnrù yīngxǔ zhī dì de zhēngchéng.) — Joshua tells the journey of the Israelites entering the Promised Land.
《士师记》记载了士师时代的信实与拯救。(《Shìshījì》 jìzǎi le shìshī shídài de xìnshí yǔ zhěngjiù.) — Judges records faithfulness and deliverance during the era of judges.
《路得记》展现了一段关于爱与忠诚的动人故事。(《Lùdéjì》 zhǎnxiàn le yí duàn guānyú ài yǔ zhōngchéng de dòngrén gùshì.) — Ruth presents a touching story about love, loyalty, and redemption.
《撒母耳记上》记载了先知撒母耳、扫罗与大卫的生平。(《Sāmǔ'ěrjì Shàng》 jìzǎi le xiānzhī Sāmǔ'ěr, Sǎoluó yǔ Dàwèi de shēngpíng.) — 1 Samuel records the lives of Prophet Samuel, Saul, and David.
《撒母耳记下》主要记录了大卫作为以色列君王的统治。(《Sāmǔ'ěrjì Xià》 zhǔyào jìlù le Dàwèi zuòwéi Yǐsèliè jūnwáng de tǒngzhì.) — 2 Samuel primarily records David's reign as king of Israel.
《列王纪上》记载了所罗门的智慧与圣殿的建造。(《Lièwángjì Shàng》 jìzǎi le Suǒluóméng de zhìhuì yǔ Shèngdiàn de jiànzào.) — 1 Kings records Solomon's wisdom and the construction of the Temple.
《列王纪下》记录了南北两国的历史与先知先见的事迹。(《Lièwángjì Xià》 jìlù le nánběi liǎng guó de lìshǐ yǔ xiānzhī xiānjiàn de shìjì.) — 2 Kings records the history of the two kingdoms and the deeds of prophets.
《历代志上》详尽记录了家谱谱系与大卫的敬拜赞美安排。(《Lìdàizhì Shàng》 xiángjìn jìlù le jiāpǔ pǔxì yǔ Dàwèi de jìngbài zànměi ānpái.) — 1 Chronicles details genealogies and David's arrangements for worship.
《历代志下》回顾了历代君王对圣殿的看重与属灵复兴。(《Lìdàizhì Xià》 huígù le lìdài jūnwáng duì Shèngdiàn de kànzhòng yǔ shǔlíng fùxīng.) — 2 Chronicles reviews the kings' devotion to the Temple and spiritual revivals.
《以斯拉记》记载了被掳归回与重建圣殿的历史。(《Yǐsīlājì》 jìzǎi le bèilǔ guīhuí yǔ zhòngjiàn Shèngdiàn de lìshǐ.) — Ezra records the return from exile and the rebuilding of the Temple.
《尼希米记》展现了同心合意重建耶路撒冷城墙的见证。(《Níxīmǐjì》 zhǎnxiàn le tóngxīn héyì zhòngjiàn Yēlùsǎlěng chéngqiáng de jiànzhèng.) — Nehemiah shows the unified effort to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
《以斯帖记》讲述了以斯帖王后勇敢拯救同胞的故事。(《Yǐsītiějì》 jiǎngshù le Yǐsītiě wánghòu yǒnggǎn zhěngjiù tóngbāo de gùshì.) — Esther tells the story of Queen Esther bravely saving her people.
《约伯记》深刻探讨了苦难的意义与坚定不移的信心。(《Yuēbójì》 shēnkè tàntǎo le kǔnàn de yìyì yǔ jiāndìng bù yí de xìnxīn.) — Job profoundly explores the meaning of suffering and unwavering faith.
《诗篇》汇集了向神倾心吐意的优美赞美与祷告诗歌。(《Shīpiān》 huìjí le xiàng Shén qīngxīn tǔyì de yōuměi zànměi yǔ dǎogào shīgē.) — Psalms compiles beautiful hymns of praise and heartfelt prayers to God.
《箴言》蕴含了敬畏耶和华与为人处世的宝贵智慧。(《Zhēnyán》 yùnhán le jìngwèi Yēhéhuá yǔ wéirén chǔshì de bǎoguì zhìhuì.) — Proverbs contains precious wisdom on fearing the Lord and living well.
《传道书》探索了日光之下生命的真正意义与归宿。(《Chuándàoshū》 tànsuǒ le rìguāng zhīxià shēngmìng de zhēnzhèng yìyì yǔ guīsù.) — Ecclesiastes explores the true meaning and destination of life under the sun.
《雅歌》用诗意赞美了纯洁美好的真爱与盟约。(《Yǎgē》 yòng shīyì zànměi le chúnjié měihǎo de zhēn’ài yǔ méngyuē.) — Song of Songs poetically praises pure love and sacred covenant.
《以赛亚书》包含了关于弥赛亚降生与救赎的伟大预言。(《Yǐsàiyǎshū》 bāohán le guānyú Mísǎiyà jiàngshēng yǔ jiùshú de wěidà yùyán.) — Isaiah contains grand prophecies of the Messiah's birth and redemption.
《耶利米书》记载了先知充满爱与警戒的忠心宣讲。(《Yēlìmǐshū》 jìzǎi le xiānzhī chōngmǎn ài yǔ jǐngjiè de zhōngxīn xuānjiǎng.) — Jeremiah records the prophet's faithful proclamation filled with love and warnings.
《耶利米哀歌》表达了对圣城的哀伤以及对神怜悯的盼望。(《Yēlìmǐ'āigē》 biǎodá le duì shèngchéng de āishāng yǐjí duì Shén liánmǐn de pànwàng.) — Lamentations expresses grief for the holy city and hope in God's mercies.
《以西结书》记载了枯骨复活等异象与荣耀重建的应许。(《Yǐxījiéshū》 jìzǎi le kūgǔ fùhuó děng yìxiàng yǔ róngyào zhòngjiàn de yīngxǔ.) — Ezekiel records visions like the valley of dry bones and promises of glorious restoration.

《但以理书》展现了在异国他乡坚守信仰与狮子坑中的蒙拯救。(《Dànyǐlǐshū》 zhǎnxiàn le zài yìguó tāxiāng jiānshǒu xìnyǎng yǔ shīzǐkēng zhōng de méng zhěngjiù.) — Daniel shows faithful devotion in exile and miraculous deliverance from the lions' den.
《何西阿书》以婚姻比喻展现神对百姓不离不弃的慈爱。(《Héxī'āshū》 yǐ hūnyīn bǐyù zhǎnxiàn Shén duì bǎixìng bùlí-bùqì de cí'ài.) — Hosea uses marriage as a metaphor for God's relentless, steadfast love.
《约珥书》预言了耶和华的日子与圣灵浇灌的应许。(《Yuē'ěrshū》 yùyán le Yēhéhuá de rìzi yǔ Shènglíng jiāoguàn de yīngxǔ.) — Joel prophesies the Day of the Lord and the promise of the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
《阿摩司书》强调了公义如江河滚滚流淌的真理。(《Āmósīshū》 qiángdiào le gōngyì rú jiānghé gǔngǔn liútǎng de zhēnlǐ.) — Amos emphasizes letting justice roll down like waters and righteousness like a stream.

《俄巴底亚书》宣告了对骄傲与不义的审判及国度归神的盼望。(《Ébǎdǐyàshū》 xuāngào le duì jiāo'ào yǔ búyì de shěnpàn jí guódù guī Shén de pànwàng.) — Obadiah proclaims judgment upon pride and hope that the kingdom shall be the Lord's.
《约拿书》启示了上帝向尼尼微全城展现的宽广恩典与怜悯。(《Yuēnáshū》 qǐshì le Shàngdì xiàng Níníwēi quánchéng zhǎnxiàn de kuānguǎng ēndiǎn yǔ liánmǐn.) — Jonah reveals God's wide grace and mercy extended toward Nineveh.
《弥迦书》教导人行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行。(《Míjiāshū》 jiàodǎo rén xíng gōngyì, hào liánmǐn, cún qiānbēi de xīn yǔ Shén tóngxíng.) — Micah teaches to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God.
《那鸿书》宣告了公义的主是患难中的坚固避难所。(《Nàhóngshū》 xuāngào le gōngyì de Zhǔ shì huànnàn zhōng de jiāngù bìnànsuǒ.) — Nahum proclaims that the Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble.
《哈巴谷书》阐明了惟义人必因信得生的永恒原则。(《Hābǎgǔshū》 chǎnmíng le wéi yìrén bì yīn xìn dé shēng de yǒnghéng yuánzé.) — Habakkuk clarifies that the righteous person shall live by his faith.
《西番雅书》宣告了默然爱你并在你中间欢呼喜乐的应许。(《Xīfānyǎshū》 xuāngào le mòrán ài nǐ bìng zài nǐ zhōngjiān huānhū xǐlè de yīngxǔ.) — Zephaniah declares God will rejoice over you with gladness and rest in His love.
《哈该书》劝勉百姓省察自己的行为并专心建造圣殿。(《Hāgāishū》 quànmiǎn bǎixìng xǐngchá zìjǐ de xíngwéi bìng zhuānxīn jiànzào Shèngdiàn.) — Haggai encourages people to consider their ways and rebuild the Temple.
《撒迦利亚书》宣告不是倚靠势力，乃是倚靠神的灵方能成事。(《Sājiālìyǎshū》 xuāngào bú shì yǐkào shìlì, nǎi shì yǐkào Shén de Líng fāng néng chéng shì.) — Zechariah proclaims: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit.
《玛拉基书》作为旧约最后一卷书呼吁百姓悔改回归神。(《Mǎlājīshū》 zuòwéi Jiùyuē zuìhòu yì juàn shū hūyù bǎixìng huǐgǎi huíguī Shén.) — As the final Old Testament book, Malachi calls people to repentance and return to God.
《马太福音》见证耶稣是旧约应许的弥赛亚与君王。(《Mǎtài Fúyīn》 jiànzhèng Yēsū shì Jiùyuē yīngxǔ de Mísǎiyà yǔ jūnwáng.) — Matthew testifies that Jesus is the promised Messiah and King.
《马可福音》生动展现了耶稣作为仆人服事人并舍命作赎价。(《Mǎkě Fúyīn》 shēngdòng zhǎnxiàn le Yēsū zuòwéi púrén fúshì rén bìng shěmìng zuò shújià.) — Mark vividly presents Jesus serving others and giving His life as a ransom.
《路加福音》详尽记述了人子耶稣寻找拯救失丧之人的慈爱。(《Lùjiā Fúyīn》 xiángjìn jìshù le Rénzǐ Yēsū xúnzhǎo zhěngjiù shīsàng zhī rén de cí'ài.) — Luke details Jesus coming to seek and save the lost.
《约翰福音》启示了道成肉身的神子以及神爱世人的真理。(《Yuēhàn Fúyīn》 qǐshì le Dào chéng ròushēn de Shénzǐ yǐjí Shén ài shìrén de zhēnlǐ.) — John reveals the Word made flesh and the truth that God so loved the world.
《使徒行传》记录了初期教会建立与福音广传的圣灵作为。(《Shǐtú Xíngzhuàn》 jìlù le chūqī jiàohuì jiànlì yǔ fúyīn guǎngchuán de Shènglíng zuòwéi.) — Acts records the early church and the Holy Spirit’s work in spreading the gospel.

《罗马书》系统阐明了因信称义、救恩恩典与基督里的新生命。(《Luómǎshū》 xìtǒng chǎnmíng le yīn xìn chēngyì, jiù'ēn ēndiǎn yǔ Jīdū lǐ de xīn shēngmìng.) — Romans systematically expounds justification by faith, grace, and new life in Christ.
《哥林多前书》第十三章详述了爱的真谛与永不止息。(《Gēlīnduō Qiánshū》 dì shísān zhāng xiángshù le ài de zhēndì yǔ yǒng bù zhǐxī.) — 1 Corinthians 13 describes the true essence and unending nature of love.
《哥林多后书》阐述了神的恩典在人的软弱上显得完全。(《Gēlīnduō Hòushū》 chǎnshù le Shén de ēndiǎn zài rén de ruǎnruò shang xiǎnde wánquán.) — 2 Corinthians expounds that God's grace is made perfect in weakness.
《加拉太书》捍卫了福音真理与圣灵所结九样果子的生活。(《Jiālātàishū》 hànwèi le fúyīn zhēnlǐ yǔ Shènglíng suǒ jié jiǔ yàng guǒzi de shēnghuó.) — Galatians defends gospel truth and living by the fruit of the Spirit.

《以弗所书》阐明了教会荣耀的奥秘与穿戴神所赐的全副军装。(《Yǐfúsuǒshū》 chǎnmíng le jiàohuì róngyào de àomì yǔ chuāndài Shén suǒ cì de quánfù jūnzhuāng.) — Ephesians expounds the mystery of the Church and putting on the armor of God.

《腓立比书》充满了在主里常常喜乐与靠着爱我们的凡事都能作。(《Féilìbǐshū》 chōngmǎn le zài Zhǔ lǐ chángcháng xǐlè yǔ kàozhe ài wǒmen de fánshì dōu néng zuò.) — Philippians is filled with joy in the Lord and doing all things through Christ who strengthens us.
《歌罗西书》高举基督在万有中居首位与至高的荣耀。(《Gēluóxīshū》 gāojǔ Jīdū zài wànyǒu zhōng jū shǒuwèi yǔ zhìgāo de róngyào.) — Colossians exalts Christ as supreme in all creation and holding first place.

《帖撒罗尼迦前书》劝勉信徒常常喜乐、不住祷告、凡事谢恩。(《Tiēsǎluóníjiā Qiánshū》 quànmiǎn xìntú chángcháng xǐlè, búzhù dǎogào, fánshì xiè'ēn.) — 1 Thessalonians encourages believers to rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.

《帖撒罗尼迦后书》坚固信徒在等候主再来时专心作正经事。(《Tiēsǎluóníjiā Hòushū》 jiāngù xìntú zài děnghòu Zhǔ zàilái shí zhuānxīn zuò zhèngjīng shì.) — 2 Thessalonians strengthens believers to stand firm while awaiting the Lord’s return.

《提摩太前书》教导年轻传道人如何治理教会与持守纯正信仰。(《Tímótài Qiánshū》 jiàodǎo niánqīng chuándàorén rúhé zhìlǐ jiàohuì yǔ chíshǒu chúnzhèng xìnyǎng.) — 1 Timothy instructs young ministers on church leadership and guarding pure faith.

《提摩太后书》勉励奔跑当跑的路、打美好的仗并持守真道。(《Tímótài Hòushū》 miǎnlì bēnpǎo dāng pǎo de lù, dǎ měihǎo de zhàng bìng chíshǒu zhēndào.) — 2 Timothy encourages fighting the good fight, finishing the race, and keeping the faith.
《提多书》指导在各地教会设立称职长老与热心行善。(《Tíduōshū》 zhǐdǎo zài gèdì jiàohuì shèlì chènzhí zhǎnglǎo yǔ rèxīn xíngshàn.) — Titus guides appointing godly elders in churches and being zealous for good works.

《腓利门书》展现了在基督里饶恕接纳与兄弟之爱的榜样。(《Féilìménshū》 zhǎnxiàn le zài Jīdū lǐ ráoshù jiēnà yǔ xiōngdì zhī ài de bǎngyàng.) — Philemon presents an example of forgiveness, reconciliation, and brotherly love in Christ.
《希伯来书》阐明了耶稣是大祭司以及信是所望之事的实底。(《Xībóláishū》 chǎnmíng le Yēsū shì Dà Jìsī yǐjí xìn shì suǒ wàng zhī shì de shídǐ.) — Hebrews expounds Jesus as High Priest and faith as confidence in what we hope for.
《雅各书》强调信心与行为并重，听道且要行道。(《Yǎgèshū》 qiángdiào xìnxīn yǔ xíngwéi bìngzhòng, tīng dào qiě yào xíng dào.) — James emphasizes faith in action—not just listening to the word, but doing what it says.
《彼得前书》勉励信徒在受苦中存活泼的盼望与圣洁的生活。(《Bǐdé Qiánshū》 miǎnlì xìntú zài shòukǔ zhōng cún huópo de pànwàng yǔ shèngjié de shēnghuó.) — 1 Peter encourages living hope and holiness amid trials and suffering.
《彼得后书》提醒防备假师傅并在恩典和知识上持续长进。(《Bǐdé Hòushū》 tíxǐng fángbèi jiǎ shīfu bìng zài ēndiǎn hé zhīshi shang chíxù zhǎngjìn.) — 2 Peter warns against false teachers and exhorts growing in grace and knowledge.
《约翰一书》见证神就是爱，住在爱里面的就是住在神里面。(《Yuēhàn Yīshū》 jiànzhèng Shén jiù shì ài, zhù zài ài lǐmiàn de jiù shì zhù zài Shén lǐmiàn.) — 1 John testifies that God is love, and whoever lives in love lives in God.
《约翰二书》勉励信徒要在真理与爱心之中行事为人。(《Yuēhàn Èrshū》 miǎnlì xìntú yào zài zhēnlǐ yǔ àixīn zhīzhōng xíngshì wéirén.) — 2 John encourages believers to walk in truth and love.

《约翰三书》祝愿凡事兴盛身体健壮正如灵魂兴盛一样。(《Yuēhàn Sānshū》 zhùyuàn fánshì xīngshèng shēntǐ jiànzhuàng zhèngrú línghún xīngshèng yíyàng.) — 3 John prays that you may enjoy good health and all go well with you, even as your soul prospers.

《犹大书》劝勉大家在至圣的真道上造就自己并在圣灵里祷告。(《Yóudàshū》 quànmiǎn dàjiā zài zhì shèng de zhēndào shang zàojiù zìjǐ bìng zài Shènglíng lǐ dǎogào.) — Jude exhorts building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit.

《启示录》揭示了新天新地的荣耀异象与基督最后的得胜作王。(《Qǐshìlù》 jiēshì le xīn tiān xīn dì de róngyào yìxiàng yǔ Jīdū zuìhòu de déshèng zuò wáng.) — Revelation reveals the glorious vision of new heavens, new earth, and Christ’s ultimate triumph.
